Notification.ConfigLoadFailed.Title: Configuration recovery
Notification.ConfigLoadFailed.Content: The configuration could not be loaded. Event Horizon started with safe defaults. Check the log for details.
Crowd.GameLimits: These are plugin decisions. Distance and the game’s own limits still determine which models are drawn.
Inspector.Title: Nearby players
Inspector.Help: Find out why someone is excluded. Reveal them for five seconds to identify them; closing this panel ends the reveal. Game limits still apply.
Inspector.Empty: No other players are currently loaded.
Panel.LimitHelp: Preferred and ordinary players share this quota. Always-kept players are additional.
Panel.EditNumber: Drag to adjust. Ctrl-click to type a number.
Panel.PopulationHelp: One cell per player. Teal: allowed. Gray: excluded. Gold: awaiting a decision. The game controls actual drawing.
Panel.OrderHelp: Keep first, then priority, then ordinary players. Arrows change priority within the same group. Ordinary players fill remaining places.
Panel.KeepHelp: Always keep these players, outside your quota. The game’s own limits still apply.
Panel.PreferHelp: Give these players quota places before ordinary players.
Panel.NormalHelp: No special preference. These players can fill remaining places.
RuleHelp.TargetFocus: Current target and focus target. Kept for 30 seconds after switching away.
RuleHelp.PartyAlliance: Members of your party or alliance.
RuleHelp.TargetingMe: Players targeting you. Kept for 60 seconds after they switch targets.
RuleHelp.RecentChat: Players who spoke in supported chat channels within the last five minutes.
RuleHelp.Nearby: Players inside the configured distance. Click the distance to change it.
RuleHelp.Race: Players matching the selected race and sex combinations. Click the count to edit.
